quiet_secondary.causal_limit: Conditioning on no subsequent event selects future quietness relative to anchor. This is descriptive, not deployable selection.

definitions.q: u-rho*z, post-clipped prediction coordinate; global main-row normalization within named scope
definitions.raw_prediction_derivative: 0.5*|clip(y)|/(W*sd_p)*q*1(-2<raw_p<2); the clipping-kink derivative is not defined and is reported inactive
definitions.orientation: sign of raw anchor model delta per target OR raw code p0/p11 delta; never sign(target), never physical-price direction
definitions.weights: Each event-window mean uses |clip(y)| for that displayed offset and target. No claim of all-event population representativeness.
definitions.mask_gates: offset_scored=(is_scored & step>=99); anchor_and_offset additionally requires anchor_is_scored & anchor_step>=99
definitions.scope: Retrospective input-selected anchor sample. Pre-event orientations use the later anchor for alignment only. Overlapping windows can repeat a row and can cross further i0 events. The secondary no-intervening-event curve joins exact cumulative counts at scored endpoints; it conditions on future quietness and still cannot identify causal latency. No curve adds to an official metric budget.
definitions.causal_limit: Event response cannot identify whether missing target increments were predictable from already available information. No shifted forecast or error correction is scored.
